TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka tou lalat si-æugh ki wæ'i ki pæ'ihababan rou mi-naunamou bavarægh, dou naunamou-al-ato [ta wæ'i] ki kpta, ni-ierroua ta ti Maria Magdalena, ti Maria-appa ka saat tou ararau-eih nein ta ravak.
S.TRANSL: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
安息日將盡，七日的頭一日，天快亮的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞來看墳墓。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytt'ei, ni-ierroua ta nynnugh ka irang: da Tama-Gnau ki Meirang ka mou-raim makka-tounnoun, ta ni-ierroua, ka ni-rihkyllen tyn ta vahto poutauagh ki nḡataf, ka ni-mierroung ta teni mi-halap ki anna.
S.TRANSL: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
忽然，地大震動；因為有主的使者從天上下來，把石頭滾開，坐在上面。

S.FORM: Ka hauwei tyn ta mahkaula ki rykkat, ka pammammien tyn ta mapoule mama ki eu'la ka maparoukapok.
S.TRANSL: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
他的相貌如同閃電，衣服潔白如雪。

S.FORM: Ka alei ki tahkot tyni-æn, ni-mæuævæuvæuh ta kmakading, ka mama ki patei ta neni.
S.TRANSL: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
看守的人就因他嚇得渾身亂戰，甚至和死人一樣。

S.FORM: Râ dou mattæ'i v'lli ta Tama-Gnau ni-k'ma ki jnæjna, ynna mahtakout ta ymoumi, ka kavana'en-au ka kmi-'ym-kamou ti Jesus-an ka nipounavæværæh-in-ato.
S.TRANSL: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
天使對婦女說：「不要害怕！我知道你們是尋找那釘十字架的耶穌。

S.FORM: Aousi ta teni hia: ni-patimæu-æ̈hæn ta teni [pæ-æhpit] mama ki na sou tyn. Mou-koua hia, k'ytt'ei ta yttou-koua-an ki ni-kalalikou-en ki Meirang.
S.TRANSL: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
他不在這裏，照他所說的，已經復活了。你們來看安放主的地方。

S.FORM: Ka ou-koua madys vanavana ki Pahtatæutæuughan tyn, ka ni-patimæu-æ̈hæn pæ-æhpit ki ni-kapatei-an: ka k'ytt'ei, siourourou ta teni ymoumi-æn mou-koua tou Galileä, tou hynna k'ytt'ei-moumi ta teni, K'ytt'ei, pattæ'i-kahan-at'mau ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
快去告訴他的門徒，說他從死裏復活了，並且在你們以先往加利利去，在那裏你們要見他。看哪，我已經告訴你們了。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka madys t'pæpænæh-hen nein ki ravak tou kahtakout-tan ki karæi-en-appa ka irang, ni-sioum ta neni alei ki hnau-en [ki atta] ki Pahtatæutæuughan tyn.
S.TRANSL: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
婦女們就急忙離開墳墓，又害怕，又大大地歡喜，跑去要報給他的門徒。

S.FORM: Jrou ka d'marang ta neni alei ki hnau-en ki Pahtatæutæuughan tyn, K'ytt'ei ni-mæuakla neini-æn ta ti Jesus, k'ma, Tabe, [maræi-ato:] jrou ka mou-koua ta neni, ni-pei-koua-an nein ta rahpal tyn, makou-Alilid tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
忽然，耶穌遇見她們，說：「願你們平安！」她們就上前抱住他的腳拜他。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ynna mahtakout, oukoua-ato hnau ki tæ'i-apapara-au ka sahkakou-'ei nein mou-koua Galileä, ka tou hynna kmytta-ah ta neni jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
耶穌對她們說：「不要害怕！你們去告訴我的弟兄，叫他們往加利利去，在那裏必見我。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka d'marang ta neni, k'ytt'ei ta rouma ki kmakading ni-mæu-æuma ta neni, ka ni-ymd-den nein hnau ki Tama-P'hik ka sibavau ta kamamang ka ni-pam't-en atou-râ.
S.TRANSL: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
她們去的時候，看守的兵有幾個進城去，將所經歷的事都報給祭司長。

S.FORM: Jrou ka mæu'i sâl-ato ki Mamoumou, ka ni-ki'ym-en nein ta sou, ni-pæ'æ̈-tapang-en nein ta malyttouk ki voual ka tama-macyt,
S.TRANSL: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
祭司長和長老聚集商議，就拿許多銀錢給兵丁，說：

S.FORM: K'ma, Mattæ'i-komma hynna ki sou ta ymoumi, ka ni-ierroua ka euvanan ta Pahtatæutæuughan tyn, ka ni-haouzoung tyni-æn tou ierppa'ni-an.
S.TRANSL: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
「你們要這樣說：『夜間我們睡覺的時候，他的門徒來，把他偷去了。』

S.FORM: Heirou ka illinghei ki Tæ'i-sou ki pourough ta anna, dmaoudalo-ah-kame tyni-æn, ka aousi-ah-kamou ki hymko ta ymoumi.
S.TRANSL: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
倘若這話被巡撫聽見，有我們勸他，保你們無事。」

S.FORM: Jrou ka ni-ara nein ta malyttouk, ni-pamut mama ki ni-pahtæutæu-hen neini-æn. Ka ni-hmavei-ah ta sou k'anna tou tamæug ki Joden tou kidi-appa ki wæ'i k'atta hnyn.
S.TRANSL: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
兵丁受了銀錢，就照所囑咐他們的去行。這話就傳說在猶太人中間，直到今日。

S.FORM: Râ sât kytti-æn 'æb ki sât ki Pahtatæutæuughan ni-thaboul mou-koua tou Galilea, tou voukkyn ka ni-si-kidi-en ti Jesus neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
十一個門徒往加利利去，到了耶穌約定的山上。

S.FORM: Jrou ka kmytta tyni-æn, ni-mako-Alilid tyni-æn ta neni, râ ni-pæg-dalæh-appa ki rÿh ta rouma-râ.
S.TRANSL: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
他們見了耶穌就拜他，然而還有人疑惑。

S.FORM: Jrou ka mou-koua mou-hylli ta ti Jesus, ni-pasousou-en tyn neini-æn, k'ma, Ni-p'hæn-koh ymmid ki kailhgen tou tounnoun ki vullum ki Næi.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
耶穌進前來，對他們說：「天上地下所有的權柄都賜給我了。

S.FORM: Anna ta mou-kou-â, mahko-veiagh-â mahtæutæuugh ki ta'utaou, mæulough neiniæn tou Nanang ki Rama, ki Alak, ki Joep-pan ka d'lligh matiktik: pahtæutæuugh-ei-moumi pa-illigh neini-æn ymmid ki mamang ka ni-pah-kou-sou-en-nau ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗 。

S.FORM: Ka k'ytt'ei, æ'ia-lam-koh ymoumi-æn tou ymmid ki wæ'i, tou kidi ki lymmou-lymmou ki yddarynnoughan. Amen.
S.TRANSL: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
凡我所吩咐你們的，都教訓他們遵守，我就常與你們同在，直到世界的末了。」
